result.summary: The environment is highly hostile to pedestrians, lacking sidewalks, marked crossings, or any dedicated pedestrian infrastructure. Pedestrians are forced to share the roadway with vehicles on a curved section of road with limited visibility due to dense roadside vegetation.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Facilities
hazards.description: No sidewalks or designated walking paths exist, forcing pedestrians to walk directly in the travel lane.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the entire roadside edge.

hazards.name: Limited Sight Lines
hazards.description: Dense vegetation on the inside of the curve restricts visibility between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curve.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Cracked and patched asphalt creates uneven surfaces and potential tripping hazards for pedestrians in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and left foreground of the roadway.

interventions.title: Install Sidewalks
interventions.description: Construct a paved sidewalk separated from the roadway to provide a dedicated and safe space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim or set back trees and shrubs on the inside of the curve to improve sight lines for all road users.

interventions.title: Roadway Markings
interventions.description: Add center lines and edge lines to better define travel lanes and improve driver predictability on the curve.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential street that is highly hostile to pedestrians due to a complete lack of dedicated infrastructure. There are no sidewalks, marked crossings, or lane markings, forcing pedestrians to share the roadway with vehicles on a surface with visible pavement degradation.

hazards.name: Lack of Sidewalks
hazards.description: Pedestrians must walk directly in the travel lane of the roadway, significantly increasing the risk of being struck by a vehicle.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway throughout the scene

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Extensive cracking and patching in the asphalt create uneven surfaces that are tripping hazards for pedestrians and can affect vehicle stability.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and middle ground of the asphalt roadway

hazards.name: Obstructed Sight Lines
hazards.description: Dense vegetation on the left side of the road curve may hide pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the road along the curve

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, paved sidewalk on at least one side of the street to provide physical separation between pedestrians and motor vehicles.

interventions.title: Lane Markings and Narrowing
interventions.description: Apply paint markings to define travel lanes and edge lines, which can help reduce vehicle speeds by narrowing the perceived roadway width.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Install speed humps or cushions to physically enforce lower vehicle speeds in this residential environment.

result.summary: A residential street environment with townhouses and sidewalks that lacks essential pedestrian crossing infrastructure. The intersection is unmarked and lacks curb ramps, while the roadway pavement shows significant cracking and wear.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: No designated crossing area for pedestrians at the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground intersection

hazards.name: Missing curb ramps
hazards.description: The sidewalk ends at a vertical curb, creating an accessibility barrier for mobility-impaired users.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right corners of the intersection

hazards.name: Degraded pavement
hazards.description: Significant cracking and wear in the asphalt surface may cause trip hazards or vehicle instability.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the roadway foreground

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint continental-style crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install sloped curb ramps with detectable warnings at all crossing points to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and repave the degraded asphalt to eliminate trip hazards and improve overall safety.

result.summary: This residential intersection features a sidewalk on the left side but lacks comprehensive pedestrian infrastructure. The wide, unmarked roadway and absence of traffic control devices at the visible corner may encourage higher vehicle speeds and increase crossing risk.

hazards.name: Wide Unmarked Roadway
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings and the width of the street can lead to higher vehicle speeds and unpredictable driver behavior.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right foreground roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: No stop signs or signals are visible to regulate vehicle movement at this intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection area

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install bold, ladder-style crosswalk markings to increase visibility of pedestrians to drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Stop Signs
interventions.description: Install stop signs to regulate traffic flow and provide clear right-of-way at the intersection.
